differences: Overall frame: the design's pale translucent panels, blue accents and mountain-photo masthead are replaced by charcoal panels, muted teal accents and a plain gradient header.
Top and sidebar: the large Mail branding, prominent blue Compose button and wide navigation rows become a compact toolbar, small pill-shaped Compose control and narrow, densely packed sidebar.
Inbox toolbar: the design's large Inbox title, message summary and prominent reply, forward, archive, delete and tag controls are missing; only a thin list heading remains.
Reading pane: the design shows an open message with subject, avatar, sender details and body; the page shows an empty white pane with a centered envelope placeholder.
Message list: large three-line rows with rounded selection highlighting become compact dark rows with tiny text, small checkboxes, inline indicators and attachment chips.
Bottom navigation: the design's full-width Mail, Calendar, Contacts and Files bar is replaced by a dark storage-status strip.
Large viewport layout: the mail application stops well above the bottom of the page, leaving a substantial blank area beneath it instead of filling the available height.
frame_issues: The header, side-panel and notification settings all display the instruction in the same top banner; neither a side panel nor a notification is visible.
Episode controls use small dark outlined buttons and a flat blue action button that do not match the design's large pale rounded toolbar controls.
